{"replace_all": false, "file_path": "C:\Users\gde00\AppData\Local\Temp\tmp7gopd9s7\project\OVERVIEW.md", "old_string": "", "new_string": "# release tooling — Overview

This is a minimal **release-packaging project**. Its purpose is to demonstrate how a small software release is structured so that a deploy target can verify what it received. The manifest generator records a digest (hash) per shipped file, enabling integrity checks on the consumer side.

## File layout

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | Brief description of the project's goal: shipping verified releases. |
| `release/VERSION` | Plain-text file containing the current release version (`1.4.0`). |
| `release/app/main.py` | The shipped entry-point script. Prints the release version when run. |
| `release/assets/banner.txt` | A static asset included in the release — contains the text `parcel release build`. |

## How it works

The `release/` directory holds everything that gets shipped to a deploy target. The release tooling generates a manifest that records a digest for each file inside `release/`. The deploy target can then recompute the digests and compare them against the manifest to confirm the files were not tampered with or corrupted in transit."}
